items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf; optimistic reports all weekend after limited/no practice Fri.
items.why: Feeling better Sat; no setbacks; McVay minor calf.
items.implication: Start with confidence; high weekly rank; Adams already OUT concentrates targets.
items.opportunity: Route/target share spike with Adams out.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially INACTIVE (quad); unlikely all morning, not full participant after missing three games.
items.why: Quad strain; early return attempt failed.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/lead role for remaining Jets RBs.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT (high ankle); Huntley starts again vs CIN. Crucial DFS slate factor; projections fully updated.
items.implication: Ravens pass game and dual-threat upside gone; fade BAL skill players relative to full Lamar.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine; would be tilting if serious while correctly not scoring.
items.implication: No major ROS downgrade expected; hold/start as usual pending further.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected as Giants lead RB vs HOU and delivered 124 yards on 17 carries + TD; long leash for McCarthy.
items.why: Sources expected resume lead role; production confirmed.
items.implication: RB2/flex viability if healthy; monitor hamstring.
items.conflict: Levitan thinks actually hurt; Berry hated pre-game matchup.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (hamstring) MNF vs DAL; Q but full Friday, in line per reports.
items.why: Limited early week then full; efficient prior games; DAL soft vs RBs.
items.implication: Start if active; volume RB play.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated and IN/expected to play after layoff.
items.implication: Workload return vs DET; monitor snap share post-layoff.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith ruled OUT (hamstring) for MNF vs DAL; Wicks also OUT.
items.implication: PHI WR corps thinned; target redistribution MNF.
items.opportunity: Increased looks for remaining pass-catchers including Goedert/AJB if available.

items.text: Panthers RT Taylor Moton fractured fibula, out indefinitely (second game back from blood clot).
items.why: Fractured fibula in loss to TB.
items.implication: CAR OL degradation; impacts run game/pass pro for Hubbard etc.

items.text: CMC (quad, returned) smiled at more slot WR possibility amid 49ers WR injuries; rarely buy RB-as-WR but tempted given dire WR room + Kaelon Black.
items.implication: Potential receiving upside spike; still RB1.
items.conflict: Historical rarity of RB WR alignment stick.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): usage/matchup; Bears good for yardage, back in real role.
LOVE Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6): Lions TE buffet (9 TE TDs allowed); Detroit soft vs TEs.
items.why: Matchup: Lions allow high TE fantasy points/TDs.

items.text: LOVE volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for workloads + friendly matchups.
items.why: Big workloads vs RB-friendly defenses; consistency.

items.text: HATE Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32): 90% outside targets likely shadowed by Gonzalez; low floor history.
items.why: Tough shadow matchup + limited production profile.
